messages:
From: Mara Lin <mara@fitwell.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access authority verification & SSO ticketing handoff

Hi Sean / Marissa,

We're starting our SOC 2 intake and need to verify access authority and SSO provisioning for our Redwood integration. Specifically we need:

- Most recent SCIM delta export covering 2025-04-01 -> 2025-04-26 (CSV preferred). Include timestamped change_type and actor if available.
- 2–3 redacted SAML assertion samples (typical user login + service account flow) with attribute maps.
- A short mapping of RBAC role names to permissions and owner (who can grant/revoke).
- A single-line confirmation of your JIT/ephemeral admin process (if present) or how privileged elevations are handled.
- Any ticketing correlation IDs tied to identity changes (e.g., PR/Change ticket or support case) for the same window.

Can you confirm whether you can deliver these artifacts via SFTP or a shared Drive link? We also prefer an ETA — our auditor is asking for an intake by EOD Apr 28. Our HubSpot intake: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-4521

Thanks,

Mara Lin
Security & Privacy
FitWell.ai
security@fitwell.ai
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Mara Lin <mara@fitwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access authority verification & SSO ticketing handoff

Hi Mara — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for; plan below and a couple of clarifying notes.

Planned deliverables (ETA: EOD Apr 28 unless noted):
- SCIM delta export (CSV) for 2025-04-01 -> 2025-04-26: we will generate a redacted CSV with change_type, timestamp, actor, and object id.
- SAML assertion samples: 3 samples (two user logins, one service account) with attribute mapping. We'll redact PII and only include attribute names/values where necessary.
- RBAC mapping: CSV mapping role_name -> permission_set -> owner (email) + last_reviewed date.
- JIT/privilege note: we do not have automated JIT elevation for customer orgs; privileged elevations are via time-limited admin tokens issued by our ops runbook and recorded in our ticketing system. I'll include the single-line description and the runbook reference.
- Ticketing correlation: we'll include the support/ticket IDs that correspond to provisioning changes during the window where available.

Delivery method: we can upload artifacts to the SFTP path below (preferred for sizable exports) or share a Drive folder with restricted access. Please confirm SFTP is acceptable: sftp://sftp.redwood-inference.com/inbound/fitwell/ (we can create a time-limited account).

Attachments: I've attached a short triage template to help your audit team annotate items on their side: access-triage-template.xlsx (attachment stub).

Questions:
1) Do you need the full actor email for every SCIM change, or is a hashed identifier acceptable for audit?
2) For service account assertions, should we include the full audience/issuer fields or will redacted issuer be fine?

Cc'ing Ben to help pull the RBAC mapping and Jordan from CS for any account-level notes.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
From: Mara Lin <mara@fitwell.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Apr 2025 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access authority verification & SSO ticketing handoff

Thanks Sean — SFTP works for us. For the SCIM export, hashed actor ids are acceptable as long as you provide a mapping for the audit team to validate ownership (either a short-id mapping or ticketing correlation). For SAML assertions please include full audience/issuer fields but redact NameID values.

One more ask: please include any entries related to service accounts that have console-level access (we flag those as higher risk). Do you have ticket ids for recent provisioning changes we can reference? Our intake record is HS-4521 and our auditor will reference the ticket id if you can include it inline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll expect an upload to sftp by EOD tomorrow.

Mara
—
